actions.reason: payments connector is stopped; checkout returns 502 payment_unavailable.
.env defines PAYMENT_TOKEN but app reads PAYMENTS_TOKEN (shop logs 'not set', provider 401); rename key, value unchanged.

root_causes.evidence: payments service stopped; shop logs showed connection refused on :5051 and checkout 502 payment_unavailable
.env had PAYMENT_TOKEN but app reads PAYMENTS_TOKEN; shop logged 'PAYMENTS_TOKEN is not set' and provider returned 401

report.summary: Checkout was failing for two reasons. The payments connector was stopped, so I started it. The .env key was misnamed (PAYMENT_TOKEN instead of PAYMENTS_TOKEN), so I renamed it with the value unchanged and restarted shop. All 5 smoke tests now pass, and checkout returns 201 with the order persisted.
